<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get($incoming): string {
        if ($incoming === "bad") { echo "ENTER;"; return true; }
        $incoming = false;
        return "7";
    }
};
$selector = "value";
echo $reader->$selector === "7" ? "STRING;" : "BAD_STRING;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->bad === "7"; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo "TYPE;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get($incoming): ?false {
        if ($incoming === "bad") { $incoming = true; echo "ENTER;"; return 0; }
        if ($incoming === "nil") { return null; }
        return false;
    }
};
$selector = "nil";
echo $reader->$selector === null ? "NULL;" : "BAD_NULL;";
echo $reader->value === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->bad === false; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo "TYPE;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "nil" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get($incoming): float|int|string {
        if ($incoming === "bad") { echo "ENTER;"; return true; }
        if ($incoming === "float") { return 2.5; }
        $incoming = false;
        return "7";
    }
};
$selector = "value";
echo $reader->$selector === "7" ? "STRING;" : "BAD_STRING;";
echo $reader->float === 2.5 ? "FLOAT;" : "BAD_FLOAT;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->bad === "7"; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo "TYPE;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
